## Purpose

Describe the user or maintainer problem this change solves.

## Changes

- Summarize the smallest meaningful set of changes.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran `pnpm verify`, or I explained why a narrower check is sufficient.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated generated Pages assets when the browser build changed.

## Product and contract boundaries

- [ ] Runtime, evidence, authority, and persistence claims remain explicit and truthful.
- [ ] Schema or fixture changes include compatibility and migration notes where required.
- [ ] The change adds no credentials, private runtime data, or unnecessary personal information.
- [ ] I reviewed the licensing, contributor-rights, and trademark guidance in `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `NOTICE.md`.

## Reviewer notes

Call out decisions, tradeoffs, generated artifacts, or areas that deserve extra scrutiny.
